package aiprompt

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

const templateCode = "practice-task.authoring-candidate.v1"
const templateVersion = 2
const maximumResponseBytes int64 = 4 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, input domain.GenerationInput) (domain.AuthoringCandidateV1, error) {
	if input.JobID == "" || input.Policy.TechnicalTaskSchema != domain.TechnicalTaskSchemaV1 || client.BaseURL == "" || client.InternalToken == "" {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, errors.New("AI authoring client is not configured")
	}
	manifestText := input.Request.Manifest
	if input.Request.PreparedSourceTask != nil {
		manifestText = input.Request.PreparedSourceTask.Content
	}
	manifestEnvelope := map[string]any{
		"text": manifestText, "source": input.Request.Source,
		"classification_hints": input.Request.Hints, "mode": input.Request.Mode,
		"manifest_digest": input.ManifestDigest,
	}
	if input.Request.Orchestration != nil {
		manifestEnvelope["orchestration"] = input.Request.Orchestration
	}
	if input.Request.PreparedSourceTask != nil {
		manifestEnvelope["prepared_source_task"] = input.Request.PreparedSourceTask
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"idempotency_key": input.JobID, "template_code": templateCode, "language_code": input.Request.Locale,
		"variables": map[string]any{
			"manifest_envelope": manifestEnvelope,
			"authoring_policy": map[string]any{
				"planner_version": input.Policy.PlannerVersion, "generation_policy_version": input.Policy.GenerationPolicyVersion,
				"tone": input.Policy.Tone, "methodology": input.Policy.Methodology, "skill_refs": input.Policy.SkillRefs,
				"technical_task_contract": map[string]any{
					"schema": input.Policy.TechnicalTaskSchema,
					"fields": []string{"goal", "student_instruction", "expected_result", "concepts", "steps", "verification"},
					"source_paths": map[string]any{
						"goal": "blueprint.scenario.goal", "student_instruction": "blueprint.scenario + blueprint.source.educational_adaptation",
						"expected_result": "blueprint.acceptance", "concepts": "blueprint.milestones.steps.learning_requirements",
						"steps": "blueprint.milestones.steps", "verification": "blueprint.evaluation",
					},
					"rules": []string{"educational_adaptation_is_student_description", "student_instruction_excludes_solutions", "steps_are_internal", "actions_are_optional", "verification_covers_expected_result"},
				},
			},
			"runtime_profiles":        input.RuntimeProfiles,
			"learning_target_catalog": input.LearningTargets,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	if int64(len(contents)) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, errors.New("AI authoring response exceeds limit")
	}
	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, fmt.Errorf("AI authoring returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	var envelope struct {
		ExecutionID        string          `json:"execution_id"`
		IdempotencyKey     string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
		TemplateCode       string          `json:"template_code"`
		TemplateVersion    int             `json:"template_version"`
		ProviderCode       string          `json:"provider_code"`
		ProviderModel      string          `json:"provider_model"`
		LanguageCode       string          `json:"language_code"`
		ResponseSchemaCode string          `json:"response_schema_code"`
		ParsedResponse     json.RawMessage `json:"parsed_response"`
		Cached             bool            `json:"cached"`
		CreatedAt          time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
		ExpiresAt          time.Time       `json:"expires_at"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || envelope.IdempotencyKey != input.JobID || envelope.TemplateCode != templateCode || envelope.ResponseSchemaCode != templateCode || envelope.TemplateVersion != templateVersion || envelope.ProviderCode == "" || envelope.ProviderModel == "" || !envelope.ExpiresAt.After(envelope.CreatedAt) {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	candidate, err := domain.DecodeCandidateShape(envelope.ParsedResponse)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	candidate.Blueprint.Source = domain.SourceProvenance{
		SourceType:            input.Request.Source.Type,
		SourceURL:             input.Request.Source.URL,
		OriginalManifestHash:  input.ManifestDigest,
		Company:               input.Request.Source.Company,
		License:               input.Request.Source.License,
		Anonymized:            input.Request.Source.Anonymized,
		EducationalAdaptation: candidate.Blueprint.Source.EducationalAdaptation,
	}
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.PlannerVersion = input.Policy.PlannerVersion
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.GenerationPolicyVersion = input.Policy.GenerationPolicyVersion
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.Method = "ai"
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.PromptTemplateRef = input.Policy.PromptTemplateRef
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.Tone = input.Policy.Tone
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.Methodology = input.Policy.Methodology
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.SkillRefs = append([]string(nil), input.Policy.SkillRefs...)
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.GenerationJobID = input.JobID
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.InputDigest = input.ManifestDigest
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.ModelProvider = envelope.ProviderCode
	candidate.Blueprint.Generation.ModelID = envelope.ProviderModel
	// Classification is trusted caller intent, never model-authored output.
	candidate.Blueprint.Classification.SurfaceClassification = input.Request.TrustedSurfaceClassification()
	if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	return candidate, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.CandidateGenerator = Client{}
